name: memory_search
description: Executes BM25-ranked SQLite FTS5 full-text search over stored facts (requiring 'query' or 'category', matching all terms first as match=all_terms then relaxing to match=some_terms, and supporting exact phrases, -exclude, UPPERCASE AND/OR/NOT, and entity_name:/tags:/content: filters) so relevant observations are retrieved rapidly, preventing full-store context dumps.

query.description: Specifies the full-text search expression (1-2000 characters, optional when 'category' is provided to list newest category facts with match=category) so matching observations are ranked by BM25 relevance, preventing unbounded table scans.

category.description: Restricts search results to a single observation category (and lists newest facts in that category when 'query' is omitted) so lookups target a specific engineering domain, preventing cross-category noise.

session_id.description: Restricts search results to observations recorded under a specific session label so task-scoped facts can be isolated, preventing unrelated session hits.

limit.description: Caps the maximum number of returned observations (1-100, default 10) so response payloads stay within prompt token budgets, preventing context window bloat.
